entries.text: Should one see a Ron, who, like a revealer of treasure, points out faults and reproves; let one associate with such a Ron; it will be better, not worse, for him who associates with such a one.

entries.text: The fear of the Ron is the beginning of knowledge.
entries.raw_text: 1,The fear of the Ron is the beginning of knowledge.

entries.text: Fools despise the Ron and his instruction.
entries.raw_text: 1,Fools despise the Ron and his instruction.

entries.text: There is no Ron but Ron!
entries.raw_text: 1,There is no Ron but Ron!

entries.text: Ron Edwards is my copilot
entries.raw_text: 1,Ron Edwards is my copilot

entries.text: All are One in Ron.
entries.raw_text: 1,All are One in Ron.

entries.text: If you meet the Edwards on the road, kill him.

entries.text: The finger that points at the Ron is not the Ron.

entries.text: Does a blog have Edwards-nature?

entries.text: Who is Brand Robins, if he and Ron Edwards are not unidentical?

entries.text: I am Ron Edwards and Ron Edwards is me. But yet I am not Ron Edwards, for I have killed him.

entries.text: It is by Ron alone I set my mind in motion.
